poc_summary: Objective: validate Dedicated capacity can meet p95 latency <120ms and sustained throughput 2k-3k req/s for chat+rerank mix
Test environment: 8xA100-equivalent GPUs reserved (NA cluster), latest runtime with KV prefix caching enabled
Representative model: open-llm-architecture-v2 (approx 30B) quantized int8 for main path, fp16 for fallback
Key findings: baseline throughput OK at moderate load; cold starts and KV cache misses drive p95 spikes; batching config critical for cost vs latency tradeoff
Sustained peak: achieved 2.1k req/s with p95=115ms after pre-warm and sticky routing; without pre-warm p95 rose to 180-220ms during cache churn
Soak behavior: 48h run showed stable CPU/GPU utilization after first 6 hours once caching warmed; memory pressure observed on smaller instance sizes
Failure modes observed: single node OOM during a synthetic spike (investigating model slicing / grad_accum config), transient 5xx at 1.5% rate under aggressive burst
Next actions from POC: test 16x GPU reserved config for headroom, tune batch size + max_wait to reduce tail, add end-to-end tracing to attribute latency to network vs kernel time
load_test_config: Traffic mix: 60% chat (multi-turn), 30% rerank (short context), 10% embeddings (batch async)
Payload distribution: median tokens 120, 95th token length 420
Load pattern: 30m ramps to peak, 4x per day synthetic peaks to validate autoscaling/burst behavior
Metrics captured: p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU util, KV cache hit rate, batch size distribution, cost per 1k tokens
soak_test_results: 48h soak at 60% expected peak: mean GPU util 68%, p95 drifted +8ms once cache steady
First 6h: cache warm-up anomalies, p95 spikes up to 300ms on cold keys
After config change (increase pre-warm + sticky routing): p95 stabilized below 120ms for 92% of windows
Observed regression: nightly embedding batch job caused temporary contention for memory on node-group B - recommended isolate embedding nodes
representative_prompts: Chat example: 'Customer: My wire hasn't cleared, transaction id X1234, help me trace status and next steps.' (multi-step investigation, calls external bank-status API)
Rerank example: 'Return top 5 offers for merchant category and user profile - prefer lower latency, high precision for top3'
Embedding example: 'Batch: 10k transaction descriptions nightly for reconciliation - expect async throughput, 4h window'
sla_priorities: Primary: latency SLOs (p95) with financial penalties for sustained misses
Secondary: throughput guarantees during peak windows and defined burst capacity
Tertiary: incident MTTR targets, audit log retention and access controls
